对光标所在的段落。选中文字时，这些按钮出现在选区旁，对选中的文字。: For the paragraph at the cursor. With text selected, these buttons appear beside the selection and work on it.
配置模型后可以改写、翻译和润色: Configure a model to rewrite, translate and polish

没有匹配的文献。换个搜索词，或按 Esc 回到完整列表调整筛选。: No matching papers. Try another search or press Esc to adjust filters in the full list.
这里的文献保留着笔记、词条和 PDF，可以恢复。它们仍会阻止同一篇文献被重复导入: These papers retain their notes, fields and PDFs and can be restored. They still prevent duplicate imports.

快捷键需要带上 Ctrl 或 Alt，或者使用 F1–F12。: Use Ctrl or Alt with another key, or use F1–F12.

把论文的 PDF 拖进文献库，或者在文献详情里附上 PDF。全文会被分成导言、方: Drop PDFs into the library or attach them in paper details. Their text will be split into introduction, methods, results and discussion for reference here.
换几个词试试，或者选中一句再查找。: Try different words or select a sentence and search again.
配置模型后，可以让模型为没有标题的全文分节、读出没有文字的页面: Configure a model to sort full texts without headings and read pages without text
模型给出的检索词，各组分别查找后合并: Model search terms, searched in groups and merged
之后随时可以用其他方式继续添加。: You can add more papers in other ways at any time.
写下主题或关键词，助手为 PubMed 等数据库拟出几条检索式并逐条试检索；你挑: Describe your topic. The assistant suggests and tests queries for PubMed and other databases. Choose useful queries to import results and run again later.
从 Zotero、EndNote 等导出的 BibTeX / RIS 文件，一批: Import BibTeX / RIS exported from Zotero or EndNote, PDFs or a folder. Subfolder names become tags.
读取本机 Zotero 数据库，带入文献信息、标签、笔记和已下载的 PDF。: Read a local Zotero database to import metadata, tags, notes and downloaded PDFs.
通过 DOI / PMID 逐篇添加，或者手动录入。: Add papers individually by DOI / PMID or enter them manually.
写下主题或关键词，助手为所选的数据库各拟几条取向不同的检索式，并立刻试检索。看命: Describe your topic. The assistant suggests and tests several queries for each chosen database. Review the results and import useful queries; you can screen individual papers after import.
主题和关键词会发送给你配置的模型；拟出的检索式会发送给所选的数据库试检索。试检索: Your topic and keywords are sent to your configured model. Queries are sent to the selected databases for a preview, which makes no changes to this library.

助手读完了，去确认它的建议: The assistant has finished. Review its suggestions
助手读待判断的文献（有全文读全文，否则读摘要），几篇同时进行，给出建议、理由和原: The assistant reads several papers at once, using full text or abstracts, and gives suggestions with reasons and quotes. Review them together or switch to “One by one” and use the keyboard. You confirm every screening decision.
什么样的文献应当收进这个文献库: Which papers belong in this library?
随时可以换一个目标：已有的建议会标为「按旧目标」，再让助手按新目标判断一遍；已判: You can change criteria at any time. Existing suggestions are marked as outdated and can be refreshed. Previously screened papers can be reviewed without changing your decisions.
点开一篇，按 Y / R / U / N 判断，A 采纳建议: Open a paper · Y / R / U / N to decide · A to accept suggestion
新导入的文献会出现在这里。: Newly imported papers will appear here.
选一个，这篇就不再出现在这里。: Choose a status to remove this paper from the queue.
引用库里的其他文献：输入作者、题目或年份: Cite another paper: enter an author, title or year
文献库里没有这篇文献。: This paper is not in the library.
这篇文献已从库里删除: This paper was deleted from the library
库里没有对得上的文献: No matching paper in the library
库里没有这个引用键: No match for this citation key
在右边的句子上点「引用」，或在这里找一篇文献。引用写作 [@Zhang2024]: Click “Cite” on a sentence or find a paper here. Citations use [@Zhang2024]; exported Markdown and BibTeX work with Pandoc.

没有配置模型，按原文的词查找：写的不是英文时几乎找不到。配置模型后，会先把这段变: No model configured. Searching with the original words, which rarely works for non-English text. Configure a model to generate English search terms.

1. Open Zotero's data directory in Settings › Advanced › Files and Folders.
2. Wait for sync, download the PDFs you need, then quit Zotero.
3. Choose zotero.sqlite from that directory below.
导入本机个人库和群组库的文献信息、标签、笔记与 PDF。分类转为 Zotero/: Import metadata, tags, notes and PDFs from local personal and group libraries. Collections become Zotero/path tags. Original files are kept; existing papers keep their records and receive additional PDFs.
这是一次本地复制，不会持续同步。暂不迁移独立笔记、PDF 批注、网页快照及其他非: This is a one-time local copy. Standalone notes, PDF annotations, snapshots and non-PDF attachments are not migrated. Relative linked files are reported for manual handling. For a partial import, export BibTeX / RIS from Zotero instead.
没有找到可导入的文献。回收站、订阅源、独立笔记和独立附件不导入。: No importable papers found. Trash, feeds, standalone notes and standalone attachments are excluded.
可以收起此窗口。返回首页或切换文献库会停止后续条目，已导入的保留；重新导入会跳过: You can dismiss this window. Returning home or switching libraries stops further imports and keeps completed items. Reimporting skips duplicates.
点击结果可查看文献: Click a result to view its paper
它的文献在回收站里，没有导入: The paper is in trash and was not imported
文献库里已有这篇，PDF 附到了原条目: Paper already in library; PDF attached to existing record
已添加 · 没认出 DOI，可在文献详情里按题目补全: Added · DOI not detected; use title lookup in paper details
正在读取第一批文件，结果会实时出现在这里。: Reading the first files. Results will appear here as they arrive.
未找到地址：本次未检索到可下载地址；下载失败：找到了地址，但未能保存 PDF。: No URL found: no downloadable file was located. Download failed: a URL was found, but the PDF could not be saved.
正在查找第一批文献，结果会实时出现在这里。: Searching the first papers. Results will appear here as they arrive.
本次没有已处理的文献。: No papers processed in this run.
多个标签用逗号或分号隔开。已有的标签不动，只添加还没有的。: Separate tags with commas or semicolons. Existing tags are kept; only new tags are added.
每个文献库是独立的文件夹：自己的数据库、PDF 和自定义词条，可以单独备份或拷走: Each library is a separate folder containing its database, PDFs and custom fields. Back it up or copy it independently.
题目、作者、期刊、年份和摘要会从 Crossref 与 Europe PMC 查: Title, authors, journal, year and abstract are retrieved from Crossref and Europe PMC. This identifier will be sent to both services.
这条记录的题目和所查的不一样，很可能是另一篇文献，所以没有预先勾选任何字段。: This record's title differs from the query and may be another paper. No fields are selected by default.
这个来源只给了部分作者，名单不完整：写入后请对照原文补齐。: This source returned only some authors. Check the full list against the paper after saving.
这条记录没有比现有内容多出什么。: This record adds nothing to the existing content.
默认只勾选现在空着的字段，以及只是文件名的题目；已有的内容，勾选后才会被替换。题: Only empty fields and file-name titles are selected by default. Existing content is replaced only when selected. Similar titles do not guarantee the same paper; open the source to check or review other candidates.
题目读自 PDF 首页，可能不全或有错：查找前请核对。: The title was read from the PDF's first page and may be incomplete or incorrect. Check it before searching.
这篇文献现在的题目只是文件名，不会拿它去查：请写上或粘贴题目。: The current title is only a file name. Enter the paper's title before searching.
可以修改用来查找的题目；文献本身的题目不会因此改变。: You can edit the search title without changing the paper's saved title.
到 Crossref、Europe PMC 和 arXiv 按题目查找，每个来源: Search Crossref, Europe PMC and arXiv for the closest titles. Only the title, authors and year are sent; PDFs are not uploaded.
点一条记录核对它的字段。排在前面只说明题目更像，是不是这一篇由你判断；预印本和正: Click a record to compare fields. A higher rank means a closer title, not a confirmed match. Preprints and published versions are separate records.
没有找到相近的记录。改一改题目再查，或者关掉这里，用「编辑信息与词条」手动填写：: No similar records found. Try another title or use “Edit information and fields” to fill details manually. A DOI is optional.
保存后先「试检索」看看命中的是不是想要的文献，再「运行」导入。检索式会发送给所选: Save, then preview results before running an import. The query will be sent to the selected database.
词条是这个文献库给每篇文献加的字段，可以填写、筛选，也可以作为表格的一列。它们只: Custom fields belong to this library. Fill them for each paper, filter by value or show them as table columns. Deleting a field also removes its values from papers.
还没有词条。可以从一组预设开始，再按自己的主题修改。: No custom fields yet. Start with a preset, then adapt it to your topic.
文本：一行自由文字，例如“实验室”“备注编号”。: Text: one free-form line, such as lab or reference number.
多值：一篇文献可以有多个值，例如物种、方法；可按值筛选。: Multiple values: several values per paper, such as species or methods; filter by each value.
单选：从固定选项里选一个，例如“证据等级：高 / 中 / 低”。: Single choice: one fixed option, such as high / medium / low evidence.
[{label}] 无法解析：对话中没有该标签，请核对。: [{label}] cannot be resolved: this label is absent from the conversation. Please check it.
[{label}] 标签对应多个来源，请核对。: [{label}] matches multiple sources. Please check it.
请先确认大纲并保存正文。: Confirm the outline and save a section first.
新稿件 {id} 已保存，但无法重新读取引用键：{err:#}: New manuscript {id} saved, but citation keys could not be reloaded: {err:#}
已保存为新稿件；请核对引用与原文。: Saved as a new manuscript. Check citations against the original papers.
它不再列在写作里。文字仍留在这个文献库的数据库中，不会被删除。: It will no longer appear in Writing. Its text is kept in this library's database.
例如 Root hairs、研究现状: For example, Root hairs or Related work
稿件至少要留一节。: A manuscript must have at least one section.
这一节写了 {words} 词，连同它的历史版本会一起删除，不能恢复。要留着文字: This section contains {words} words. Its text and history will be deleted permanently. Export or copy the manuscript first to keep them.
已恢复这一版。恢复前的文字也留了一个版本，可以再换回去。: Version restored. The previous text was also saved as a version so you can return to it.
候选句来自文献里不属于导言、方法、结果、讨论的段落。综述的各节、致谢、展望都可以: Candidates come from paragraphs outside introduction, methods, results and discussion. Use this for review sections, acknowledgments or outlooks.
候选句来自文献库里的文献在这一部分的句子。: Candidates come from this part of papers in your library.
停笔 {} 秒，或换到别的一节时，这一节的文字有了变化就会留一个版本，最多 {}: When you pause for {} seconds or switch sections, changed text is saved as a version, up to {} versions.
恢复时，现在的文字会先留一个版本，所以恢复也可以撤回。: Restoring saves the current text as a version first, so it can also be undone.
这个文献库还没有自定义词条。在左下角「自定义词条」里添加，例如物种、研究方法、所: No custom fields in this library. Add species, methods or projects using “Custom fields” at the bottom left.
添加后可以在这里预览，全文也会用于提问。也可以替你找开放获取的版本：只取能免费合: Attach a PDF to preview it and use its text for questions. You can also find an open access copy; only freely available files are downloaded. DOI or PMID will be sent to OpenAlex, Europe PMC and publishers.
助手的建议在这里一起过目：不同意的改掉，拿不准的不勾选，再把勾选的一次写成收录判: Review suggestions together: change disagreements, uncheck uncertain papers, then save checked decisions in one step. Nothing changes until you confirm; confirmation can be undone.
没有勾选的文献：勾选要写入的，或回到队列。: No papers checked. Select papers to save or return to the queue.
队列里没有待判断的文献了。新导入的文献会再出现在筛选里。: No papers await screening. New imports will appear here.
用一两句话概括这篇文献发现了什么：写结论，而不是做了什么。: In one or two sentences, what this paper found: the conclusion, not what was done.
说明（可留空）：让助手提取时找什么，例如“研究用的物种，写学名”: Description (optional): what the assistant should look for, e.g. “species studied, by scientific name”
助手逐篇阅读（有全文读全文，否则读摘要），为勾选的词条提出取值，并摘一句原文作依: The assistant reads each paper (the full text when stored, otherwise the abstract), proposes a value for every checked field and quotes one sentence of the paper as evidence. These are proposals only: look them over in Extract, and only the checked ones are saved to the fields.
这个文献库还没有自定义词条。先添加要提取的词条，例如物种、研究方法、样本量。: This library has no custom fields yet. Add the fields to extract first, such as species, method or sample size.
勾选要让助手填写的词条。: Check the fields the assistant should fill.
重新提取：已有取值或已经问过的也再问一遍: Extract again: also ask where a field has a value or was asked about before
助手还在读上一轮，等它结束或先停止。: The assistant is still on the previous run. Wait for it to finish, or stop it first.
没有要读的：这些文献的这些词条都已经填好，或已经问过。勾选「重新提取」可以再问一: Nothing to read: these fields are filled or were asked about already for these papers. Check “Extract again” to ask once more.
这些文献没有摘要，也没有保存全文，助手没有可读的内容。: These papers have no abstract and no stored full text, so there is nothing for the assistant to read.
这篇文献没有摘要，也没有保存全文，没有可读的内容。: This paper has no abstract and no stored full text: nothing to read.
模型没有回答这个词条。: The model did not answer for this field.
助手还在读，等这一轮结束再写入。: The assistant is still reading. Save once this run is over.
未填写 · 助手没有在文中找到: Empty · the assistant found nothing in the paper
助手读文献，为自定义词条提出取值，每个取值附一句原文。在这里过目：不对的不勾选，: The assistant reads papers and proposes values for the custom fields, each with a sentence of the paper. Look them over here: leave the wrong ones unchecked, then save the checked ones to the fields together. Nothing changes before you save, and saving can be undone.
没有勾选的取值：勾选要写入的，或把用不上的清除。: No values checked: check those to save, or set aside the ones you have no use for.
默认勾选：词条还空着、且找到了原文依据的取值。: Checked by default: values for a field that is still empty, with a sentence of the paper found for them.
它提出的取值会陆续出现在这里。可以先去做别的，侧栏里看得到进度。: The values it proposes will appear here as they come. You can do something else meanwhile: the sidebar shows the progress.
先有词条，才有可提取的: Fields first, then something to extract
词条是这个文献库给每篇文献加的字段，例如物种、研究方法、样本量。添加之后，助手可: Fields are what this library adds to every paper, such as species, method or sample size. Once they are there, the assistant can find each paper's values in its text for you.
助手提出的都处理完了。新加的文献或词条，可以再让它读一遍。: Everything the assistant proposed has been dealt with. For new papers or fields, have it read again.
助手没有在读过的文献里找到这些词条的内容。没有摘要也没有全文的文献，它读不了。: The assistant found nothing for these fields in the papers it read. It cannot read a paper with neither an abstract nor a full text.
让助手读列表里的文献，为词条找出取值和原文依据。也可以在文献列表里选中几篇，右键: Have the assistant read the papers in the list and find values for the fields, with a sentence of the paper for each. You can also select a few papers in the list and right-click “Fill fields with assistant”, or click ✦ by a field of one paper to ask about that field alone.
先回到队列，让助手判断待判断的文献；它给出建议后再来这里确认。: Return to the queue and ask the assistant to screen papers first.
搜索图注、图号、标签、备注，或所属文献…: Search captions, labels, tags, notes or source papers…
这张图的文献已不在库里。: The source paper is no longer in this library.
它的图注、标签和备注会一起删除。图片文件不会被删除，会移到文献库文件夹下的 re: Its caption, tags and notes will be removed. The image file moves to the library's removed folder. The PDF and paper are kept.
图注：这张图画的是什么: Caption: what does this figure show?
用逗号隔开，例如 配色, UMAP, 示意图: Separate with commas, e.g. colors, UMAP, diagram
为什么收藏它、想借鉴什么: Why save it? What would you like to learn from it?
这张图片读不出来，文件可能被移走了。: This image cannot be read. The file may have moved.
还没有配置模型。在「设置 › AI」里填好一个能看图的模型，它就可以看着图写图注: Configure a model with image support in Settings › AI to suggest captions, tags and interpretations.
没有可以给模型看的图片。: No image available for the model.
已收藏到图片库，在左侧「收藏」里的「图片」下。: Saved to figures, under Favorites › Figures in the sidebar.
图号和图注是从这一页上读出来的，收藏前看一眼，不对的地方改掉。: The label and caption were read from this page. Check and correct them before saving.
这一页上没有找到挨着它的图注，可以自己填，也可以先留空。: No nearby caption found on this page. Enter one or leave it blank.

用到这个模型时，问题和相关文献的记录、笔记、全文页面（筛选时是待判断的文献，翻译: Questions and related paper records, notes and full-text pages are sent to this service (pending papers for screening; titles and abstracts for translation). API keys are stored as plain text in local settings.json.
OpenAI 的 Responses 接口（/responses），地址写到 /: OpenAI Responses (/responses), with a base URL ending in /v1. API keys are stored as plain text in local settings.json.
适用于任何兼容 chat/completions 的服务，地址写到 /v1。用到: For chat/completions-compatible services, use a base URL ending in /v1. Questions and paper content are sent to this service. API keys are stored as plain text in local settings.json.
思考：「默认」不发送思考参数，由模型自己决定；其余各档按 effort 发送。「: Thinking: Default omits the parameter and lets the model decide. Other levels send effort. Off disables thinking for tasks such as translation; Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable use the lowest level instead because they require thinking.
思考：「默认」不发送思考参数。各档按 reasoning_effort 发送，「: Thinking: Default omits reasoning parameters. Other levels send reasoning_effort; extra-high and maximum use high. Off depends on the provider: reasoning_effort: none, enable_thinking: false or thinking: disabled. If the model rejects it, return to Default.
思考：「默认」不发送推理参数。各档按 reasoning.effort 发送，「: Thinking: Default omits reasoning parameters. Other levels send reasoning.effort; extra-high and maximum use high, Off uses none. If the model rejects it, return to Default.
只用于这个模型服务。留空则使用「网络」页的全局代理；填 direct 表示不走代: Only for this model service. Leave blank to use the global proxy in Network, or enter direct to bypass proxies.

助手和单篇文献的对话。向导拟检索式、图片库里看图写图注和标签、写作页的改写、润色: The assistant and conversations about a paper. Also writes the setup guide’s queries, figure legends and tags, and rewrites, polishes and places citations on the writing page; reading figures needs a model that accepts images.
逐篇阅读文献：筛选页的批量建议、复核和单篇再问，以及提取页按词条填写。文献多的时: Reads papers one by one: batch suggestions, rechecks and single-paper asks on the screening page, and filling in custom fields on the extraction page. For large libraries, you can choose a faster, cheaper model.
批量筛选时同时发出的请求数。服务限速时调小。: Concurrent batch screening requests. Lower this if the service rate-limits requests.
批量翻译标题或摘要时同时发出的请求数。服务限速时调小。: Concurrent requests when batch translating titles or abstracts. Lower this if the service rate-limits requests.
翻译题目、摘要和 PDF 里选中的文字；写作页把你写的话变成候选句的检索词也用它: Translates titles, abstracts and text selected in a PDF; also turns what you write into search words for candidate sentences on the writing page. A small model with thinking turned off is usually sufficient.

可以放进多个模型，各做各的事：点一个模型展开它的设置，修改会自动保存。下面的「任: Add multiple models for different tasks. Click a model to expand it; changes save automatically. Assign tasks below.
没有单独指定模型的任务，使用助手的模型。: Tasks without a specific model use the assistant’s model.
可以在这里指定别的目标语言、术语的译法或输出的格式。要求改了以后，同一段文字会按: Specify a target language, terminology or output format here. Changing instructions triggers a new translation; existing translations are cached in this library.
发给模型的就是这段话。写上 {} 的地方换成命令后面的内容，这时命令后面必须写内: This text is sent to the model. Each {} is replaced with content after the command, which is then required. Without {}, the template can run alone; any content is appended.
用过它的对话保留着当时发出的内容，不受影响。: Previous conversations retain the content sent at the time.
把常用的提问存成一条命令：在提问框里输入 / 就能选到它，选中后可以接着写内容，: Save frequent prompts as commands. Type / to choose one, add content if needed, and press Enter to send. Commands are prompts; they do not run scripts, add tools or bypass approval. Scope, model and citation checks work as usual. Changes save locally without contacting the model.
内置命令不能修改，也不能被同名的命令替换。: Built-in commands cannot be edited or overridden by commands with the same name.
文献检索、元数据查询、检查更新和模型请求都经过它。修改会自动保存，下一次请求起生: Used for literature searches, metadata lookups, updates and model requests. Changes save automatically and apply to the next request.
支持 http、https、socks4、socks4a、socks5、sock: Supports http, https, socks4, socks4a, socks5 and socks5h, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://127.0.0.1:1080.
留空时使用环境变量 ALL_PROXY、HTTPS_PROXY、HTTP_PRO: When blank, uses ALL_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY and NO_PROXY. Each model can override this in AI, or use direct. The wisp CLI shares this setting. Proxy URLs, including credentials, are stored as plain text in local settings.json.
本地优先的文献库：收集文献、整理、预览 PDF、对文献库提问。: A local-first literature library: collect, organize, preview PDFs and ask about your papers.
Wisp Paper 以 MIT 协议发布；随附的第三方组件见 THIRD_PA: Wisp Paper is released under MIT. See THIRD_PARTY.md for bundled third-party components.
它们的笔记、词条和 PDF 都留着，可以在回收站里恢复。: Their notes, fields and PDFs are kept and can be restored from trash.
把这次对话作为综述来写: Use this conversation to write a review

改动后要重新确认要求和大纲；已保存的正文和证据都留着。: Changes require reconfirming requirements and outline. Saved sections and evidence are kept.
改动后要重新确认大纲；已保存的正文和证据都留着。: Changes require reconfirming the outline. Saved sections and evidence are kept.
自由记下的证据情况，例如哪些文献只读到摘要、哪里还缺证据。: Notes on evidence, such as abstract-only sources or missing support.
核对过什么、还有什么没能核对。保存后算作对当前内容的检查。: What was checked and what remains unverified. Saving marks the current content as checked.

请先等回答结束。: Wait for the answer to finish first.

写作要求已确认。接着问就会进入大纲。: Writing requirements confirmed. Continue to plan the outline.
已记为大纲。看一遍，需要的话在「查看记录」里修改，然后确认。: Saved as outline. Review it in “View record”, make any changes, then confirm.

记下一条论断和它的依据: Record a claim and its evidence
原来的来源已不在文献库里，请另选一篇。: The original source is no longer in this library. Choose another paper.
页码是 PDF 里从 1 数起的第几页。摘录会和文献保存的文字比对，结果写在这条: Pages are numbered from 1 in the PDF. Quotes are checked against saved text; you still judge whether the source supports the claim. Changing the claim, source, page or quote invalidates the previous judgment.
来源已不在文献库里（或在回收站），恢复后才能判断。: The source is no longer in the library or is in trash. Restore it before judging.

回答依据文献库里的记录、笔记和已存 PDF 的全文，并标出出处。需要时助手会自己: Answers use library records, notes and saved PDF text, with citations. The assistant can search and read full text as needed.
和助手就整个文献库有过的对话；点开一次可以接着说。单篇文献的对话在各自的「提问」: Conversations with the assistant about the whole library. Open one to continue. Conversations about a single paper are under that paper’s “Ask” tab

第一个问题会带上这些文献：范围就是文献列表现在的样子，由视图、搜索和筛选决定。点: The first question includes these papers, determined by the current views, search and filters. Opening a paper here does not change the scope.

PubMed 检索式：布尔运算符 AND / OR / NOT 要大写，用括号分: PubMed: use uppercase AND / OR / NOT, parentheses for groups and quotes for phrases. Field tags include "single cell"[Title/Abstract], Arabidopsis[MeSH Terms], 2020:2025[dp]. A trailing * truncates a word.
Europe PMC 检索式：布尔运算符 AND / OR / NOT 要大写，: Europe PMC: use uppercase AND / OR / NOT, parentheses and quoted phrases. Prefix fields, e.g. TITLE:"root", ABSTRACT:"single cell", PUB_YEAR:[2020 TO 2025], SRC:PPR for preprints.
Crossref 按词语匹配题目、作者和期刊，不支持布尔运算符和字段：只写 3: Crossref matches words in titles, authors and journals. It does not support Boolean operators or field tags. Use 3 to 6 distinctive words.
arXiv 检索式：字段前缀 ti:（题目）、abs:（摘要）、au:（作者）、: arXiv: use ti: for titles, abs: for abstracts, au: for authors, cat: for categories (e.g. cs.CL) or all:. Use uppercase AND / OR / ANDNOT, parentheses and quoted phrases.

从已有综述得来的框架。改动后要重新确认它和大纲；已保存的正文和证据都留着。: The framework drawn from published reviews. Changes require reconfirming it and the outline. Saved sections and evidence are kept.
写作要求已确认。下一步读已有综述，得出初步框架。: Writing requirements confirmed. Next, read the published reviews for a starting framework.
已记为初步框架。看一遍，需要的话在「查看记录」里修改，然后确认。: Saved as starting framework. Review it in “View record”, make any changes, then confirm.
初步框架已确认。下一步对照它，按文献库的证据重建大纲。: Starting framework confirmed. Next, rebuild the outline against it from the library's evidence.
不参照已有综述。下一步按文献库提出大纲。: Going on without published reviews. Next, plan the outline from the library.
从已有综述得来：它们各问什么、怎么组织、哪里没讲到。它只是起点，大纲要对照它、按: Drawn from published reviews: what each asks, how it is organized, and what it leaves out. It is only a starting point; the outline is rebuilt against it from the studies in the library.
还没有记下。让助手读已有综述、提出初步框架后，点回答下面的「记为初步框架」；没有: Not saved yet. Ask the assistant to read the published reviews and propose a starting framework, then click “Save as framework” below its answer. With no review to draw on, click “Skip” above.
没有参照已有综述。: No published reviews were drawn on.
还没有记下。让助手对照初步框架重建大纲后，点回答下面的「记为大纲」。: Not saved yet. Ask the assistant to rebuild the outline against the starting framework, then click “Save outline” below its answer.
请找出这个主题已发表的综述，逐篇比较，再提出初步框架。: Find the published reviews on this topic, compare them one by one, then propose a starting framework.
没有可参照的综述时，直接按文献库拟大纲: With no review to draw on, plan the outline from the library directly
请按文献库里的文献提出大纲。: Propose an outline from the papers in the library.
请对照初步框架，按文献库里的研究重建大纲。: Rebuild the outline against the starting framework, from the studies in the library.

关闭窗口后应用留在程序坞中，检索同步、筛选和导入照常进行；点程序坞图标回到窗口，: Closing the window leaves the app in the Dock; search syncs, screening and imports carry on. Click the Dock icon to bring the window back, ⌘Q to quit.
关闭窗口后应用留在通知区域，检索同步、筛选和导入照常进行；点托盘图标回到窗口，在: Closing the window leaves the app in the notification area; search syncs, screening and imports carry on. Click the tray icon to bring the window back; quit from its menu.
OpenAI 的 Responses 接口（/responses），地址写到 /: OpenAI's Responses API (/responses); the URL ends at /v1. Conversations are not stored on the server: each request carries the whole conversation, and the model's reasoning comes back encrypted with it. When one of this provider's models is used, the question and the content of the papers concerned are sent to it. The API key is stored in plain text in settings.json on this computer.
一个服务可以提供多个模型，各个任务用哪一个在「任务」里选。修改会自动保存在本机的: A provider can offer several models; choose which one each task uses under Tasks. Changes are saved automatically to settings.json on this computer.
在左边添加一个服务，填上它的 API Key。: Add a provider on the left and enter its API key.
没有单独指定模型的任务，使用助手的模型；助手没有指定时，用第一个填好了 API: A task without a model of its own uses the assistant's; without one for the assistant, the first model with an API key is used. Translations are kept in the library and not requested again.
用到这个服务的模型时，问题和相关文献的记录、笔记、全文页面（筛选时是待判断的文献: When one of this provider's models is used, the question and the records, notes and full-text pages of the papers concerned (when screening, the papers waiting for a decision; when translating, titles and abstracts) are sent to it. The API key is stored in plain text in settings.json on this computer.
留空则使用「网络」页的全局代理；填 direct 表示不走代理。: Leave blank to use the global proxy from Network; enter direct for no proxy.
留空则用默认的要求。可以指定别的目标语言、术语的译法或输出的格式；改了以后，同一: Leave blank for the default instructions. You can name another target language, how terms are translated or the output format; after a change, the same text is translated again under the new instructions.
还没有模型：在下面写上模型名称，按 Enter 添加。: No models yet: type a model name below and press Enter.
连同它的模型一起删除；用到它们的任务改用默认的模型。: Deletes it with its models; tasks that used them fall back to the default model.
适用于任何兼容 chat/completions 的服务，地址写到 /v1。用到: For any service compatible with chat/completions; the URL ends at /v1. When one of this provider's models is used, the question and the content of the papers concerned are sent to it. The API key is stored in plain text in settings.json on this computer.
